title: Building the Bond and Qudwah with Your Child (Ages 4-6)
description: A 14-day tarbiyah journey that helps the father build a secure emotional bond with his child in the preoperational stage (Piaget preoperational) through dramatic play, daily dialogue, and short stories, with practical application of the principle of qudwah (role modeling) that begins from the father himself.

primary_reference.info: عبد الله ناصح علوان، تربية الأولاد في الإسلام، الجزء الأول — الفصل الثالث (اللعب والرفق)

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the adjective 'تربوية' (educational/upbringing) while the English uses the noun transliteration 'tarbiyah', an Islamic term not explicitly present in the source. This adds a religious connotation and changes the part of speech.
